name: image-reveal
title: Image Reveal Hover
description: Four oversized text rows, each with a small category tag, that fade in a related photo while the pointer is on them. The picture follows the cursor and vanishes when you leave.
use: Editorial links deserve a preview image without a thumbnail grid.
avoid: Hover only, so touch users never see a preview; every photo is a remote Unsplash URL.
a11y: Rows are divs with hover-only handlers; keyboard and screen-reader users get no preview or link. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four oversized white labels stacked with thin divider lines, each with a tiny category word and square marker at the far right. A small rounded photo can appear wherever the pointer is over the list.
behaves: Hovering a row fades in the photo tied to that row; the picture springs toward the cursor as it moves and fades out when the pointer leaves the list.
customise: The four labels, tags and image URLs are a hardcoded array; spring stiffness and image size are fixed in the file.
weight: light: Four rows and one spring-tracked image; nothing runs when idle.
